query: Hi there, I’m having trouble sending and receiving text messages on my phone, even though I have that limited edition neon green silicone phone case that came free with my plan last quarter. Let me list out what I’ve noticed so far: I have airplane mode turned on, my network preference is set incorrectly, Wi-Fi calling isn’t working properly, the SMS permission for my messaging app is broken, my mobile data is off, I’ve exceeded my data usage limit, my SIM card feels like it might be loose, I’m currently traveling abroad and I have roaming turned off. Can you help me fix this?
